text:
anya: noticed p95 popped in the dashboard for endpoint-A in eu with minimal movement in p99. anyone else catching this?
jared: saw it during a quick glance. slice: /v1/generate -> eu -> endpoint-A. short spike ~5m.
marta: classic small-sample volatility, but could also be sampling policy differences per rollout bucket.
liam: also double-check whether the console is mixing aggregation_mode=raw vs rollup-derived for that slice. mismatch will shift mid-quantiles.
anya: console query shows `use_raw_samples=false` for that composite. curious if telemetry-config flip recently changed preserve_sample_counts.
metrics-bot: telemetry-bot applied telemetry-config v2.3 to staging at 1750056700 (preserve_sample_counts=false)
jared: hypothesis: p95 rose because a cohort of medium-latency requests moved into the observation window while the heavy-tail (p99) stayed the same. lower sample_count makes p95 jumpier.
marta: I'm pulling a histogram for the spike window and checking prefix cache hitrate. increased cache misses would lift the midtail.
liam: also look at routing logs for any temporary fallback weight shift. I skimmed recent route weights and saw a tiny bump earlier:
```
route: generate
weights: {primary: 0.76, fallback-slow: 0.24}
```
if fallback weight crept up, that explains midtail inflation.
anya: can someone paste the breakdown numbers (p50/p95/p99 and sample_count) for the spike window? want to see sample delta.
jared: running query now, results (1750056600-1750056700): p50=110ms, p95=480ms, p99=1750ms, sample_count=210. previous window sample_count=420.
marta: histogram confirms mass shifted from 90-150ms to 250-500ms. p99 unchanged since few >1s requests remained. drop in sample_count explains sensitivity.
liam: agreed. UX idea: Surface sample_count delta and aggregation_mode badge next to percentile values. Also indicate whether raw samples are used. will sketch a PR for the console.
anya: yes please. Add a tiny provenance indicator like "samples:210 (-50%) | mode:rollup" and a tooltip that expands to show recent telemetry-config. that would cut down noisy p95 alerts. :white_check_mark:
